CEREMONIALBEAST-PLOW.title: Plow
CEREMONIALBEAST-PLOW.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 [strength]Strength[/strength] and lose 1 [agility]Agility[/agility] per stack. Taking unblocked damage removes 1 stack.
CEREMONIALBEAST-RINGING.title: Ringing
CEREMONIALBEAST-RINGING.description: You cannot play cards. Removed at the end of your turn.
